notes.title: Punch a Plant - Steam Next Fest Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050275/74eb3ce0cf34cc1e04ba8ea35857422ab3c7be8a.png[/img]

Wow! In just a few days, Steam Next Fest has already given Punch a Plant a massive boost in wishlists and players! We're truly grateful for all the attention and support. Seeing so many of you jump in and test the game has been amazing!

If you haven't tried it yet, now's the perfect time—Punch a Plant is an experience worth playing! And if you're enjoying it, feel free to spread the word.

A huge thank you to everyone who's played so far! 💚 Keep the punches coming!

notes.title: VR Workout? Punching Plants Burns Calories!
notes.content:
Did you know that playing Punch A Plant! for 30 minutes burns approximately 690 ish calories? That's roughly the same as dodging an angry banana tree in real life.

In all seriousness, VR games keep you moving, and Punch A Plant! is no exception. So next time someone asks if you're ‘just playing games,’ remind them:
✔ Full-body movement
✔ Intense reflex training
✔ The satisfaction of wrecking mutant plants

Who needs the gym when you’ve got VR? 💪🌱

notes.title: 🚀 New Cover, New Punchy Look! 🥊
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve just updated our game’s cover art—and no, it’s not just because we had too much coffee (although… maybe a little).

[b]Why the change?[/b]
While Punch A Plant! definitely grabs attention (because, let’s face it, who wouldn’t be curious about punching a plant?), we realized it wasn’t fully resonating with the download numbers and wishlists we’re aiming for. It’s like landing a solid punch but missing the knockout.

Our goal? To make the store page feel as dynamic as the game itself! We’re on a quest to find the right audience, the perfect VR warriors, and the communities that love chaotic, over-the-top action as much as we do.

So, what do you think of the new look? Does it make you want to punch… uh, play more? 😄
Let us know your thoughts—we’d love to hear from you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050275/b0d34f560dcf09248803e17dddb3ec7c5b9d781f.png[/img]
